column3: “Breath” here is the same Hebrew word as “spirit” and “wind.”
“Bring up flesh” is rendered “make flesh grow back.”
“Breath” is the same Hebrew word as “winds” in this verse.
“Piece of wood” is rendered “stick,” and “associates” as “companions.”
The Hebrew says “I will put them on it, the stick of Judah”; NASB has “put them with it.”
“Dwelling places” follows the Hebrew; many read “backslidings.”
“I will give them” is rendered “I will place them”; the LXX lacks this phrase.
